## Fixes

- **A config that doesn't load is no longer silent.** When the config on disk stops loading (a syntax error, an unreadable file, or a deleted one), the gateway keeps serving the last good config. Dropping every tool on a typo would punish you. But that also means a revocation in a broken hand edit hasn't taken effect. Now `toolhost status`, `toolhost doctor` and bare `toolhost` say `config invalid since <time>: <error>; still running the previous config`, and `doctor` exits 1 until the config loads again.
- **Tools that don't resolve are no longer silent.** When two servers claim one tool name, the gateway serves no tools from any server until the clash is gone, as in v0.0.4. Now `status`, `doctor` and bare `toolhost` say `could not resolve the tools since <time>: <error>; serving no tools from any server until they resolve`, and `doctor` exits 1 while it lasts.
- Both reports cover every gateway on the config, stdio ones included, and they work even when the config no longer parses.
- Deleting the config used to go unnoticed by a running gateway. It now counts as a config that doesn't load.
- Bare `toolhost` with a broken config used to print nothing and exit 0. It now reports the error and exits 1.
- For a config that exists but doesn't parse, `doctor` now says to correct the file. It used to suggest `toolhost init`, which refuses to overwrite it.

## Changes you might notice

- `GET /status` and `toolhost status --json` carry `config_error` and `resolve_error`, each `{since, error}`, while they last.
- While a gateway isn't serving what its config says, it keeps a note at `degraded/<pid>.json` in the environment's state folder, `~/.toolhost/degraded/` for the global one. The note goes when the fault does, or when the gateway stops.

## Release pipeline

- The verify step now names the repository when it downloads the draft release. In v0.0.4 the step failed, and the release was verified and published by hand.

## Verify the download

```bash
cosign verify-blob --bundle checksums.txt.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/gettoolhost/toolhost-local/.github/workflows/release.yml@.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  checksums.txt
sha256sum -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
gh attestation verify toolhost_darwin_arm64.tar.gz -R gettoolhost/toolhost-local
```
